description: This Java source file defines the CategoryServices class, providing static methods for handling product category operations such as retrieving category members, navigating previous/next products, and building category trees within an e-commerce platform using OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CategoryServices
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for managing product categories and related data in OFBiz.

methods.name: getCategoryMembers
methods.description: Retrieves members of a specified product category, including handling errors and caching.

methods.name: getPreviousNextProducts
methods.description: Finds previous and next product IDs within a category based on ordering and filtering criteria.

methods.name: getCategoryFindEntityName
methods.description: Determines the appropriate entity name for category product listing based on ordering fields and date limits.

methods.name: getProductCategoryAndLimitedMembers
methods.description: Fetches a limited set of product category members with filtering options such as stock status and view permissions.

methods.name: getChildCategoryTree
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical JSON structure representing child categories for a given category, suitable for tree views.
